== Printed roles and imported metadata ==
[[:File:ANH-D-danzborin-decipher-archive.gif|The physical Decipher archive face]] and both dated PC images describe a gunner and bounty hunter in lore. The article characteristic list now uses those printed roles. The previously unqualified Black Sun agent tag is not printed on these faces. The current bare GEMP class and generated metadata likewise list gunner and bounty hunter as intrinsic keywords; official card JSON has an additional Black Sun entry whose taxonomy intent is not established here. This source comparison does not claim a deployed-engine fix. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).
